simple.meaning: literally a failure of flesh , i.e. emaciation ; figuratively, hypocrisy
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כַּחַשׁ (H3585) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כַּחַשׁ (kachash) means literally a failure of flesh , i.e. emaciation ; figuratively, hypocrisy First listed occurrence: Hos 7 3.

definitions.full: H3585. kachash כַּ֫חַשׁ noun masculine Job 16:8 1 lying . 2 leanness ; — absolute ׳כ Hosea 12:1-2 t.; כָּ֑חַשׁ 10:13 ; suffix כַּחֲשִׁי Job 16:8 ; plural suffix כַּחֲשֵׁיהֶם Hosea 7:3 ; — 1 lying , כ ׳מְּרִי אֲכַלְתֶּם Hosea 10:13 ye have eaten the fruit of lying ; 7:3 (|| רָעָה ), 12:1 ; of Nineveh, ׳כ מְלֵאָה מֶּרֶק Nahum 3:1 of lying (and) robbery it is full ; Psa 59:13 (|| אָלָה ). 2 of Job's affliction Job 16:8 my leanness hath risen up against me (compare Psa 109:24 ; ᵑ7 J Gen 41:27 ; Eccl 12:5 ; Talmud כחשׁא ; > my lying , i.e. my affliction regarded as a lying witness, Di Buhl and others)
